what: Keeping 0-RTT tickets between processes needs the bytes of a TLS 1.3 client session, and rustls 0.23 has no serializer for Tls13ClientSessionValue, so rustls is vendored and patched (to_bytes, tls13_ticket_from_bytes). Separately, the h3 tokio driver matches h3::Event exhaustively, so each new event variant (the request events here) breaks a file another lane is deleting.
cost: a vendored dependency to keep in step with upstream; a hand-off for the tokio driver's match (five arms) or its deletion before the tree compiles
cause: resumption state is the TLS library's private type, with no stable byte form; and the driver contract makes every driver interpret every event, rather than routing each event to its asker by kind
class: state a sans-IO core must hand its driver is locked inside a dependency's private type; a closed event enum matched in full by each driver
prevention: send rustls upstream a serializer for client sessions and drop the patch; drivers route events by the asker they name (session, stream, request) through one `asker()` on Event, so a new kind of asker is one file's change
workaround: vendor/rustls with SOURCE.md naming the patch; the tokio driver is being deleted in favour of drivers on blaze-core's effects
